mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invocation_usage ( invocation_id, provider, model, provider_session_id, total_input_tokens, last_request_input_tokens, usage_precision, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, context_input_tokens, raw_usage_json, provider_cli_version, observed_at ) VALUES ( #{invocationId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{providerSessionId}, #{totalInputTokens}, #{lastRequestInputTokens}, #{usagePrecision}, #{inputTokens}, #{cachedInputTokens}, #{cacheCreationInputTokens}, #{cacheReadInputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{reasoningOutputTokens}, #{contextInputTokens}, #{rawUsageJson, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.ObjectJsonTypeHandler}, #{providerCliVersion}, #{observedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), model = VALUES(model), provider_session_id = VALUES(provider_session_id), total_input_tokens = VALUES(total_input_tokens), last_request_input_tokens = VALUES(last_request_input_tokens), usage_precision = VALUES(usage_precision), input_tokens = VALUES(input_tokens), cached_input_tokens = VALUES(cached_input_tokens), cache_creation_input_tokens = VALUES(cache_creation_input_tokens), cache_read_input_tokens = VALUES(cache_read_input_tokens), output_tokens = VALUES(output_tokens), reasoning_output_tokens = VALUES(reasoning_output_tokens), context_input_tokens = VALUES(context_input_tokens), raw_usage_json = VALUES(raw_usage_json), provider_cli_version = VALUES(provider_cli_version), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at)
mapper.select: SELECT invocation_id, provider, model, provider_session_id, total_input_tokens, last_request_input_tokens, usage_precision, input_tokens, cached_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_output_tokens, context_input_tokens, raw_usage_json, provider_cli_version, observed_at FROM invocation_usage WHERE invocation_id = #{invocationId}
